id.description: A static value used internally by Terraform, this should not be referenced in configurations.

keepers.description: Arbitrary map of values that, when changed, will trigger recreation of resource. See [the main provider documentation](../index.html) for more information.

length.description: The number of bytes requested. The minimum value for length is 1.

result_base64.description: The generated bytes presented in base64 string format.

result_hex.description: The generated bytes presented in hex string format.

block.description: The resource `randombyte_bytes` generates random bytes that are intended to be used as secret or keys.
